recognize_zh: 成片小到中型母細胞，核圓或略有凹陷、染色質均勻細緻、細胞質極少且無顆粒，有些細胞帶手鏡狀尾巴，外觀均一，符合前驅 B 細胞淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Sheets of small-to-medium blasts, about 1.5-2 times a red cell
High N:C ratio with scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval or slightly indented nuclei; one cell with a tapered hand-mirror cytoplasmic tail
Fine, homogeneous chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; few residual normal cells
describe_en: The smear shows a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts with high N:C ratios, round to indented nuclei, fine homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Occasional cells have hand-mirror cytoplasmic projections. Auer rods and granules are absent, and normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. The morphology favors lymphoblasts; findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD22, TdT, CD34) and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts look the same and are distinguished by cytoplasmic CD3 expression without B-lineage markers.
AML-M0 blasts are also agranular but are MPO-negative by cytochemistry yet MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117-positive by flow and TdT-negative or weak.
Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum by flow (CD34 to CD20) rather than a monotonous, blocked immature population.
Blastoid MCL cells are TdT/CD34-negative, surface Ig-positive and cyclin D1-positive.
